answer: The garden register is checked at draw time, horizon lists the eligible set, and marble seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 36 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 36 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 252 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
